title: Backup Problem
body:
Hi everyone,
My partner has been using AAPS for several months and had successfully completed all the objectives. Unfortunately, her phone screen broke a few days ago, and we’ve had to replace the device.
Since I hadn't made a recent backup of the AndroidAPS settings (lesson learned!), we are starting from scratch on the new phone. Is there a way to bypass or fast-forward through the objectives to get back to where we were? We had already reached the stage where SMB (Super Micro Bolus) was fully active.

Thank you all so much for your help!

comments.body: Okay, thanks a lot, I changed the code and it fixed it. Thanks a lot.
